title: val vs var
instructions: Which of the following statements about `val` and `var` is correct?

options.text: val and var are interchangeable; there is no difference
val declares a variable that can be reassigned; var declares one that cannot
val declares a variable that cannot be reassigned; var declares one that can
var is not valid Kotlin syntax

explanation: `val` (value) creates an immutable binding -- once assigned, it cannot point to a different value. `var` (variable) creates a mutable binding that can be reassigned. Prefer `val` whenever possible to keep your code predictable.
